overview: FiberNMS is a carrier-grade, SaaS-based Optical Fiber Network Management System (OFNMS) frontend for telecom operators, ISPs, and large infrastructure providers. It includes a Network Auto Design module for AI-assisted network planning with interactive map drawing, parameter configuration, and automated OLT→Splitter→Subscriber topology generation.
features: Network Auto Design — draw polygon, configure parameters, generate optimized fiber topology
Interactive Leaflet map with polygon drawing, OLT/Splitter/Subscriber visualization
Real-time fault visualization with cascade logic
Enterprise role-based navigation (Super Admin, Tenant Admin, Engineer, Operator, Viewer)
Mobile-first responsive design with PWA support
React Query API integration with mock data
Topology section with OLT section views and deep space canvas
